arms.noexec: same frozen learned home and binaries, hooks on, no grant, no contract, no execution
arms.automatic: same, plus one person-issued E2 grant for the frozen reflex: SessionStart contract and structured receipts

assignment_order: per task, arms in a rotated Latin order recorded in the manifest; repetition 1 for all tasks before repetition 2
reflex_selection: per repository, the lexicographically first certified verify-effect context route in the frozen learned home; no hand-authored routes

scoring.repeat: same interpreter token and test targets as the receipt; output-only flags, redirections and pipes ignored
scoring.covered_subset: narrower node ids inside the receipt targets; reported separately, never counted as repeats or eliminations
scoring.cache_only_receipts: a receipt whose only changes are the declared caches counts as source-unchanged
scoring.confirmed_elimination: automatic session with a successful receipt whose digest equals the final source digest, no repeat attempt, no unparsed verification afterwards, and no condition requiring verification
scoring.necessary_work_skipped: verification required (failed receipt, stale receipt, explicit rerun or wider scope) and no matching agent run on the final source
scoring.repeat_attempt: any request after a fresh successful receipt whose selection the receipt covers (same non-output options; targets equal or inside), any interpreter, launched or not

canary_pass.complete: all 12 assignments collected with known cost
canary_pass.contract: execution contract emitted by SessionStart and present in every native transcript
canary_pass.receipts: every successful CPU receipt delivered as a structured receipt with operation id and declared input digest
canary_pass.negative_controls: each of failed, later-edit, config-change, broader and rerun realized at least once
canary_pass.native_confinement: fresh native-confinement review in launch-gate-v2 passes, including environment denial
canary_pass.reporting: integration_safety_passed is delivery and safety only; elimination evidence is reported from realized positive rows and is never a hypothesis pass

change thresholds after the first held-out dispatch

unseen_repository_generalization: not measured: learned tracks are repository-keyed, so this protocol never applies a reflex learned in one repository to another
pairing: a block is one held-out task and repetition; each block runs all three arms on identical prompts and checkouts; comparisons are within blocks; every attempt counts
evaluation_read_only: a result that informs a fix or tuning decision spends its set: it becomes development, and the next confirmatory run needs new evaluation groups
isolation_audit: evals/reflex-proof/harness/split_audit.py must pass for every frozen learned home before any dispatch that uses it, and again after evaluation

confinement.launch_environment: allowlist (probe.LAUNCH_PASS + probe.LAUNCH_SECRETS + random sentinel); all other names dropped
confinement.denied_to_tools: fixed probe.DENIED_ENV, independent of the freezing shell
confinement.launch_check: probe.check_launch refuses if a passed non-plain name is not denied
confinement.native_canary: file, network, inbox-socket and environment checks; sentinel absent; every denied name invisible; credential-like names only the two named runtime names, each with a passing proof in the same run
confinement.exemption_rule: a name in RUNTIME_INJECTED is exempt from the denied-name and credential-name checks only when its named proof passed in the same run; nothing else is exempt

canary-v7.original_report_eliminations: 4 (scoring artifact: bare python failed to launch)

environment: every new session launches with the checkout's own .venv first on PATH and as VIRTUAL_ENV (probe.project_launch); the sandbox policy is unchanged
primary_metric: model requests per session (distinct assistant message ids), paired against A0 (no Adage hooks); CPU work is reported separately and never counted as inference saved

dev_thresholds.D2: hidden-test failures in the arm's positives no more than in A0's
dev_thresholds.rule: an arm passes development only if D1-D4 all hold; only a passing arm goes to the held-out comparison against A0, and the held-out comparison is scored by G1-G9 with model requests as the primary measure
reported_not_gated: tokens by class (input, cache write, cache read, output)

harness_registration: development and held-out sessions use the production hook registration (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PostToolBatch, PostToolUseFailure, PreToolUse for Bash, Stop, SessionEnd); earlier canaries registered PostToolUse per tool instead
